UNAUTHENTICATED: You need to sign in. Please sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this. Contact your company manager if you need access.
NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find this item. It may have been archived or is outside what you can view.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check your input. Fix the highlighted fields and save again.
VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else saved changes first. Load the latest version and save again.
STALE_REVISION: This item changed before you confirmed it. Review the latest version and confirm again.
ALREADY_CONFIRMED: This has already been confirmed. Please refresh the page.
FILE_TYPE_REJECTED: This file type isn’t supported. Upload a file in one of the allowed formats.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is too large. Reduce it below the size limit and upload again.
FILE_CORRUPT: We couldn’t read this file. Save the original again and re-upload it.
FILE_NOT_READY: This file is still being processed. Please try again in a moment.
INVITE_INVALID: This invitation link can’t be used. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.
INVITE_USED: This invitation link has already been used. Please sign in instead.
INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: Your account email doesn’t match the invited email. Sign in with the invited email.
SLUG_TAKEN: This company handle is already taken. Enter a different handle.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
CONFLICT: This can’t be done in the current state. Refresh the page and try again.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again shortly.
